name: TRACE-ANALYTICS
description: Full-stack user analytics application with JavaScript event tracking, Node.js/Express APIs, MongoDB storage, React dashboard, session journeys, and interactive click heatmaps.

paragraphs: Full-stack website interaction analytics for the Full Stack Engineer assignment. TRACE Analytics captures browser page views and clicks, stores events in MongoDB, and presents session activity, user journeys, and click heatmaps through an authenticated dashboard.
Public HTML Website: Open the website Source Code: RICK2814/TRACE-ANALYTICS
This is the single public HTML website highlighted for the assignment. GitHub main is the source of truth, while the live deployment may lag behind the newest source revision.
features: A browser-side JavaScript tracker observes page views and clicks on the linked HTML website.
Each event includes a session identifier, event type, page URL, timestamp, and click coordinates when relevant.
The Node.js/Express backend validates incoming events and saves structured records through Mongoose.
An Admin-authenticated React dashboard presents session totals, chronological user journeys, and a click heatmap.

whatItDoes.text: Full-stack website interaction analytics for the Full Stack Engineer assignment. TRACE Analytics captures browser page views and clicks, stores events in MongoDB, and presents session activity, user journeys, and click heatmaps through an authenticated dashboard.

requirements.text: Open the Vite URL printed in the terminal and sign in as Admin.
Open the linked HTML website, click its Account control, choose Sign in to TRACE, then select the Admin role and enter the credentials.
